title: 'Pursuing the Spirit' Highlights First Museum to Focus on Religious, Spiritual Dimensions in Contemporary Art
summary_en: Pursuing the Spirit: The Museum of Contemporary Religious Art, a new book by the former director of SLU's Museum of Contemporary and Religious Art (MOCRA) offers an extensive and generously illustrated treatment of the first museum to focus on the religious and spiritual dimensions in contemporary art.
title_cn: 'Pursuing the Spirit' Highlights First Museum to Focus on Religious, Spiritual Dimensions in Contemporary Art
